name: Arcjet
description: Secures AI agents and apps at runtime: detects prompt injection, enforces tool-call policies, redacts sensitive data, and blocks bots, through SDKs, an MCP server, and a CLI.

skills.name: Prompt Injection Detection
skills.description: Detects prompt injection attempts in prompts and untrusted input before an agent or model acts on them.

skills.name: Guard Policies
skills.description: Authorizes agent tool calls and actions against policies written in Rego, with drafting, validation, and test evaluation.

skills.name: Sensitive Info Detection
skills.description: Detects sensitive information such as PII in requests and agent traffic so it can be blocked or redacted.

skills.name: Bot Protection
skills.description: Identifies and blocks automated clients and abusive traffic on HTTP routes, API endpoints, and agent entry points.

skills.name: Request Investigation
skills.description: Explains why a request was allowed or denied and analyzes traffic, anomalies, and IP threat intelligence for a site.
